name: Command Message
summary: Adversaries may send unauthorized command messages to instruct control system assets to perform actions outside of their intended functionality, or without the logical preconditions to trigger their expected function. Command messages are used in ICS networks to give direct instructions to control systems devices. analytics.name: Analytic 1926
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Windows process generating Industrial Control System (ICS) command messages to field device tags representing physical outputs, from a process that is not the recognized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or Distributed Control System (DCS) control application, targeting safety-critical output tags.
